title: Beneath the Pipes
summary: The Faithful talked about pipes, and Mara's note agrees: the cult moves its prisoners through old rusted pipes (a Cult of Azazel structure). Find the pipes and the keeper's log hidden in a barrel there.

goals.say: Old pipes, rusted, going nowhere. Underneath: cracks, and a cold breath coming up.

goals.name: Pipe-Keeper's Log

quest_book.title: Pipe-Keeper's Log
quest_book.author: A Believer
pages: The pipes carry the prayers down. Do not ask where down is.
New stock moved to the believer house. Keep them fed. The Sacred City wants them alive.

goals.say: The log names a believer house.
